artifacts.summary: Implementation summary covering the five-phase bimodal test-helper consolidation and the full four-theory gate results.

next_steps: Task is fully implemented; the plan's five phases are all [COMPLETED] and the full four-theory gate plus per-theory unit suites are green.

completion_data.completion_summary: Consolidated all eight genuinely duplicated _settings/_build helpers in the bimodal test tree onto tests/_build_support.py (five _settings-only duplicates, two full-pipeline duplicates, one differently-named duplicate renamed at its call sites), refreshed _build_support.py's module docstring, and verified with the full four-theory gate (647 passed/5 skipped) plus per-theory unit suites (1277 passed). The two non-candidates (unit/test_structure.py's documented verify='off' wrapper and unit/test_witness_constraints.py's unrelated _build_selector_family) were left untouched as scoped.

reflection.what_worked: Re-running the discovery grep fresh and reading every matched helper body against _build_support.py's before editing (rather than trusting the plan's enumerated count) caught the stale test_output_gate.py docstring immediately and confirmed every other module's classification matched the plan with zero divergence.
reflection.what_was_hard: The first full four-theory gate run hit a transient Z3 segfault in an unrelated file (test_timeout_resources.py, never touched by this task); confirming it was pre-existing flakiness rather than a regression required an isolated re-run of that file plus a clean retry of the full gate.
reflection.what_was_missed: Nothing identified; the plan's scope hypothesis matched the tree exactly at both Phase 1 and Phase 5 re-checks.
reflection.successes: All five phases closed cleanly in order with a green commit at each boundary; final four-theory gate and per-theory suites both green with zero regressions and zero assertion/setting changes.
